Purpose A single calling knowledge base combining stage-wise scripts, simple FAQ answers, system actions and stop conditions. 1. Global script rules Keep sentences short, conversational and neutral. Do not ask the customer to repeat or disclose an OTP, full PAN, Aadhaar number, bank password, UPI PIN, card PIN or CVV. Do not promise approval, sanction, a specific rate, a higher limit, withdrawal, disbursal or a guaranteed processing time. Do not send or claim to send a link. Stop immediately for opt-out, complaint, sensitive trigger, ineligibility, stage completion or campaign/contact cap. Customer FAQs and approved answers Use these answers when the customer asks a related question. Keep the wording simple and do not add unapproved information. # Customer question Recommended answer / knowledge response Intent / routing 1 What does “eligible offer” mean? It is the loan amount you may be able to get against your eligible mutual funds. Please check the amount shown in your LAMF journey. Offer explanation 2 Is the eligible amount equal to my total mutual fund value? No. The loan is calculated only on eligible mutual funds and units. A lending limit is also applied, so the loan amount will be lower than your total mutual fund value. Eligibility 3 Why are some

lue? No. The loan is calculated only on eligible mutual funds and units. A lending limit is also applied, so the loan amount will be lower than your total mutual fund value. Eligibility 3 Why are some mutual funds not displayed? Mutual funds that meet the loan rules are only shown. Locked, restricted, or unsupported schemes may not appear. Scheme eligibility 4 Can I choose which mutual funds to pledge? Yes. You can select from the eligible mutual funds shown. Your loan amount may change based on your selection. Scheme selection 5 What do “current value”, “maximum limit” and “selected limit” mean? “Current value” is the present value of the selected mutual fund. “Maximum limit” is the highest loan available against it. “Selected limit” is the amount you have chosen. Screen terminology 6 Can I choose a smaller loan amount? Yes, where the journey permits, you may choose a lower amount within the shown permitted range. Amount selection 7 Why did the loan amount change after I selected funds? Your loan amount depends on the mutual funds and units you select. Adding or removing funds can change the available amount. Recalculation 8 What is “pledge value”? It is the value of the mutual

unds? Your loan amount depends on the mutual funds and units you select. Adding or removing funds can change the available amount. Recalculation 8 What is “pledge value”? It is the value of the mutual fund units you are offering as security for the loan. Terminology 9 Does selecting funds sell or redeem them? No. Selecting the funds does not sell them. The selected units will be pledged later through MF Central. Pledge concern 10 Will I lose ownership of my mutual funds? No. The mutual fund units remain in your name. A lien is placed on the selected units as security for the loan. Ownership concern 11 Why are lien marking and lien removal charges shown? These are charges for creating and later removing the lien on your mutual funds. Please check your KFS and loan agreement for the exact charges. Charges 12 Can I change the selection after continuing? If the Back or Edit option is available, you can change the selection before confirming the pledge. After the pledge is completed, a separate process may be required. Journey navigation 13 What should I do if the amount shown is lower than expected? Please check the eligible mutual funds and units selected in the journey. If the

a separate process may be required. Journey navigation 13 What should I do if the amount shown is lower than expected? Please check the eligible mutual funds and units selected in the journey. If the amount still looks incorrect, please raise a support request. A higher amount cannot be guaranteed. Objection 14 Does the offer guarantee approval or disbursal? No. You must still complete KYC, pledge, documents, e-Mandate and the final checks. Wait until the timer ends and select “Resend OTP”. Also check your spam or junk folder and make sure the email address is correct. OTP troubleshooting 5 Should I tell you my OTP? No. Never share your OTP with me or anyone else. Enter it only on the official LAMF, DigiLocker or service-provider page. Security 6 Why am I being redirected to DigiLocker? It is needed to collect your EMI or interest automatically after you use the loan facility. Mandate rationale 3 Which bank account will be used? The mandate will use the verified bank account shown on the e-Mandate page. Please check that the bank and account-holder details are correct. Bank selection 4 Why does the page show “customer name as per bank account”? It shows the name registered with the bank for that account. The name is used to verify that the account belongs to you. Name match 5 What does “maximum amount” mean? It is the highest amount that the mandate allows the bank to debit. It does not mean this full amount will be debited every time. Only the amount due will be collected. Mandate amount 6 What is the first collection date? It is the

the mandate allows the bank to debit. It does not mean this full amount will be debited every time. Only the amount due will be collected. Mandate amount 6 What is the first collection date? It is the earliest date from which repayment may be collected. Please check your repayment schedule for the actual due dates. Collection date 7 Why am I asked to select a verification mode? You need to choose one of the available bank-verification methods, such as net banking, to register the e-Mandate. Verification mode 8 Should I share my bank password, OTP or PIN with the caller?
